question: K is the product of the greatest and the smallest of the numbers (1)/(4), (2)/(3), (4)/(5), (5)/(8), (3)/(4) . Find the value of ( {frac{{{1}}}{{{k}}} {{ + }} {{4}}} )( {frac{{{1}}}{{{k}}} {{ - }} {{2}}} )
solution:
Given:

K is the product of the greatest and the smallest of the numbers (1)/(4), (2)/(3), (4)/(5), (5)/(8), (3)/(4) . 

Concept used:

Concept of comparing fractions

Calculation:

Given numbers,

{1 over 4} = {1 over 4} × 120 = 30

{2 over 3} = {2 over 3} × 120 = 80

{4 over 5} = {4 over 5} × 120 = 96

{5 over 8} = {5 over 8} × 120 = 75

{3 over 4} = {3 over 4} × 120 = 90

Hence, 

Greatest number = {4 over 5}

Smallest number = {1 over 4}

thus,

k = {4 over 5} × {1 over 4} = {1 over 5} and 1/k = 5

Now,

( {frac{{{1}}}{{{k}}} {{ + }} {{4}}} )( {frac{{{1}}}{{{k}}} {{ - }} {{2}}} )

⇒ (5 + 4) (5 - 2)

⇒ 9 × 3

⇒ 27

∴ The value of( {frac{{{1}}}{{{k}}} {{ + }} {{4}}} )( {frac{{{1}}}{{{k}}} {{ - }} {{2}}} ) is 27.
